scope: W3-A local rehearsal of production integration. No production access, no production migration created, no client cutover.

superseded_and_retained.reason: shard emitted alias before its accepted-target anchor; IdentityRegistry.load() refuses that ordering
contained 19 iNaturalist-native canonical anchors; iNaturalist is a discovery/reference provider, not the identity backbone

supabase_migrations_touched_note: supabase/drafts/ is intentionally OUTSIDE supabase/migrations/. supabase db reset and supabase migration up never see these files.

check_constraints: scope_state in (include, review, exclude, not_evaluated, required_ancestor) or null

external_mapping.conflict_invariant: same-target reapply idempotent; DIFFERENT target raises inside install_release_chain and rolls back the whole chain

identification_snapshot.immutability_trigger: identification_snapshot_immutability_trg — blocks UPDATE of original_* while snapshot_locked=true
identification_snapshot.note: historical fields NEVER rewritten by resolver

resolution_link.note: later resolution overwrites this row but NEVER the identification_snapshot

release_installation.note: release-ID reuse with different hashes RAISES; idempotent reinstall of same hashes succeeds

supplement_installation.note: declared depends_on graph is materialised and enforced by FK

observations_integration.column_added: public.observations.resolved_sporely_taxon_id integer references taxonomy_v3.registry_concept(sporely_taxon_id) on delete set null
observations_integration.write_guard: trigger w3a_guard_resolved_sporely_taxon_id_trg — rejects updates to the column from any role except service_role or the local postgres superuser
observations_integration.link_function: taxonomy_v3.link_observations_to_resolution() — service_role only; single UPDATE that respects the guard trigger; touches only resolved_sporely_taxon_id

migration_phases: phase 1 — install schema draft on local disposable stack (W3-A, done)
phase 2 — human-authorised port to a Supabase migration under supabase/migrations/, plus the RLS policies (NOT W3-A)
phase 3 — install the release chain on a staging Supabase project via install_release_chain() (NOT W3-A)
phase 4 — apply the reconciliation manifest on staging (NOT W3-A)
phase 5 — link_observations_to_resolution() on staging; smoke-test read paths (NOT W3-A)
phase 6 — dual-read client rollout with feature flag off by default (NOT W3-A)
phase 7 — feature-flag flip to prefer canonical link where non-null (NOT W3-A)
phase 8 — dual-write RPC for AI-identification (NOT W3-A)
phase 9 — legacy-column deprecation (much later; not yet planned)

invariants_verified_local.search_cache_membership_note: base release's taxon_external_id.jsonl still holds 52,881 rows keyed on col_xr:col_usage_id; the two supplements added 22 out-of-cache concepts + 22 external mappings; the base cache count is untouched

rls_and_security_results.foreign_key_behaviour_on_delete_registry: SET NULL on public.observations.resolved_sporely_taxon_id; SET NULL on resolution_link.resolved_sporely_taxon_id; RESTRICT on external_mapping.sporely_taxon_id

rollback_results_local.after_cutover_mode_note: design in w3a-rollback-plan.md; not exercised in W3-A because no cutover has occurred

remaining_blockers: porting supabase/drafts/*.sql into supabase/migrations/ requires human authorisation and its own review pass
operationalising the reconciliation manifest (rebuild + service-role storage) requires the operator's key + local reconciliation runner outputs; those must NOT be committed
search_taxa_v3 RPC design + implementation for dual-read cutover
exact_production_steps_that_require_huma: supabase link + supabase migration new (creating a real migration from the draft SQL files)
manually running install-release-chain.mjs against a staging Supabase project
granting service_role to any operator or CI environment
toggling a client feature flag from legacy-only to dual-read
